Francisco Sá Carneiro Airport (OPO)
From Porto airport to your bed, without overthinking it.
Porto’s airport is close and on the metro. For most people the metro is the answer. A pre-booked driver earns its price late at night, with children, or with more bags than hands.
Four ways in
Metro, taxi, transfer, car
1. Metro, line E (violet).

From the station at arrivals to Trindade in about half an hour; change there for São Bento or Gaia. Buy a rechargeable Andante card at the machines. It does not run all night — check the last train if you land late.
2. To the coast.
For
Póvoa de Varzim or Vila do Conde
, take line E and change at Verdes to line B (red).
3. Taxi or ride-hailing.
From the rank or pick-up zone outside arrivals. Fine for two people with luggage.
4. Pre-booked transfer.
A driver with your name in arrivals, a fixed price agreed before you fly. The calm choice for a late landing, a family, or a group.

How do I get from Porto airport to the city centre?
Metro line E (violet) runs from the airport to Trindade in central Porto in about half an hour. Taxis and ride-hailing wait outside arrivals, and pre-booked transfers meet you inside.
Can I get from Porto airport to Póvoa de Varzim by metro?
Yes. Take line E and change at Verdes to line B (red) toward Póvoa de Varzim. Vila do Conde is on the same line.
